source_formula: For positive ranges: raw[t]=mean(range[t-4:t+1]); pass[t]=(0.5*raw[t]<=range[t]<=1.5*raw[t]). If pass[t-1] is false, use raw[t]. Otherwise each offset1..5 takes its range if passing, else nearest more recent passing offset; average five slots including repeats. Evaluate at last closed H1.
calculation_window: 10 positive closed H1 bars; each own raw5 filter; no execution-hour OHLC
refresh: Recompute on each closed H1, freeze through next hour
labels_are: Derived from explicit author conditions under the recorded project convention; not individually confirmed exact execution hours
inferences: hi0=high is inferred from the High-Low methodology; the declaration is above the screenshot viewport.
Choose the reproducible indicator excerpt over the separate manual similar-bar method.
Use only closed H1 bars; this deliberately prevents an unfinished trigger bar from changing its own ATR.
limitations: Full Pine program is not available and the port has not been executed in Pine.
Zero-range bars and missing warmup abstain; Pine var/na startup semantics are not inferred.
Manual 4-5 similar bars with 1.8/0.5 exclusion is a different method and is not merged with this indicator.
closed_bar_primary_evidence: source_unit-0003.md at 02:11:24.620: only after the bar closes include its size in ATR
